title: Contract Tests for Event-Driven Services
excerpt: REST teams learned contract tests a decade ago. Behind an async bus, producer deploys still break consumers silently when schemas drift without consumer-driven verification.
description: Staff patterns for event-driven contract testing: consumer-driven contracts, semver for event schemas, CI provider verification, and DLQ metrics for poison messages.
socialThreadTr: Async event'te producer deploy consumer'ı sessizce kırar; contract test şart. 🧵

sections.heading: Async failures stay silent
paragraphs: Producers assume new fields are optional; consumers deserialize strictly and messages land in the DLQ without a page.
Consumer-driven contracts lock expected payload shapes in code reviewable artifacts, not tribal JSON examples.

sections.heading: Consumer contracts before deploy
paragraphs: Plan major bumps and dual-publish windows for breaking schema changes.
Run old and new schemas in parallel during migration so rollback does not require replaying a day's events.
points: Verify consumer contracts before producer deploys ship

sections.heading: Version events like public APIs
paragraphs: Async buses fail quietly when producers merge schema changes consumers never verified. paragraphs: Block producer deploys when provider verification fails, not only consumer deploys, or you recreate monolith release trains in slow motion. Track the change in your service catalog, review thresholds quarterly, and attach a dated rollback ticket before the next launch window.

sections.heading: Async contracts that survive deploy order
paragraphs: Event-driven systems fail quietly when producers ship schema changes consumers never verified. Treat published event schemas like HTTP OpenAPI: semver breaking changes, consumer-driven contract suites, and provider verification jobs in continuous integration before either side merges. CloudEvents envelopes help, but payload fields still need explicit compatibility rules and fixture data representative of production cardinality. Negative contract fixtures should run on every provider pull request. Publish dashboards beside error budgets, run game days before major releases, and record owner sign-off in the same change ticket the on-call engineer will read first.

Pact or equivalent tools should run on both sides—consumers publish expectations, producers prove they emit matching shapes under recorded scenarios. Block producer deploys when verification fails, not only consumer deploys, or you recreate the monolith release train in slow motion. Version negotiation headers or topic suffixes beat silent dual writes that fork analytics pipelines. Publish dashboards beside error budgets, run game days before major releases, and record owner sign-off in the same change ticket the on-call engineer will read first.

Dead-letter queues surface poison messages and schema drift faster than grep in logs. Metric DLQ depth, processing lag, and error taxonomy by event type. Contract tests must include negative cases: unknown fields ignored, required fields missing, and enum extensions forwarded without crash. Document which teams own which event types in a catalog linked from pull request templates. Treat registry drift like API deprecation with explicit sunset dates. Publish dashboards beside error budgets, run game days before major releases, and record owner sign-off in the same change ticket the on-call engineer will read first.

Game days replay production traffic samples into staging buses with redaction to validate contract changes under load. Legal and privacy reviews apply to event payloads the same way they apply to REST bodies—do not log full payment or health events to shared topics. Quarterly audits diff emitted schemas against the registry and retire orphaned topics before they become shadow databases. Registry diffs should block deploy when orphaned topics still receive traffic. Publish dashboards beside error budgets, run game days before major releases, and record owner sign-off in the same change ticket the on-call engineer will read first.

sections.heading: 不受发布顺序影响的异步契约
paragraphs: 当生产者发布消费者从未验证的 schema 变更时，事件驱动系统会静默失败。将发布的事件 schema 当作 HTTP OpenAPI：semver 破坏性变更、消费者驱动契约套件，以及任一方合并前的 CI 提供者验证。CloudEvents 信封有帮助，但 payload 字段仍需明确兼容规则与代表生产基数的 fixture。
Pact 或等价工具应双侧运行——消费者发布期望，生产者在录制场景下证明 emit 匹配形状。验证失败时应阻断生产者部署，而非仅阻断消费者，否则会以慢动作重现单体发布列车。版本协商头或 topic 后缀优于 fork 分析管道的静默双写。
DLQ 比日志 grep 更快暴露 poison message 与 schema drift。按事件类型指标化 DLQ 深度、处理滞后与错误分类。契约测试须含负例：未知字段忽略、必填缺失、枚举扩展转发且不崩溃。在 PR 模板链接的目录中记录各事件类型 owner。
Game day 将 redact 后的生产流量样本 replay 到 staging 总线以在负载下验证契约变更。法务与隐私评审同样适用于事件 payload——勿将完整 payment 或 health 事件写入共享 topic。季度审计将 emit schema 与 registry diff，退役成为 shadow database 的 orphan topic。

ja.excerpt: RESTには契約テストが普及；非同期バス裏で規律がないとプロデューサーデプロイがコンシューマーを静かに壊す。スキーマレジストリだけでは不足。

sections.heading: event を public API のように version
paragraphs: producer が consumer 未 verify schema merge すると async bus は静かに fail。semver、fixture、PR リンク registry ownership 付き event contract publish。 サービスカタログで変更を追跡し、四半期ごとに閾値をレビューし、次の launch ウィンドウ前に日付付き rollback チケットを紐付けてください。
CloudEvents は metadata 標準化；payload は optional field policy が要る。 サービスカタログで変更を追跡し、四半期ごとに閾値をレビューし、次の launch ウィンドウ前に日付付き rollback チケットを紐付けてください。
consumer-driven suite は deploy merge 前に両側 CI。 サービスカタログで変更を追跡し、四半期ごとに閾値をレビューし、次の launch ウィンドウ前に日付付き rollback チケットを紐付けてください。

sections.heading: producer ship 前に verify
paragraphs: provider verify fail で producer deploy も block、consumer のみ禁止。 サービスカタログで変更を追跡し、四半期ごとに閾値をレビューし、次の launch ウィンドウ前に日付付き rollback チケットを紐付けてください。
DLQ metric が poison message を log grep より速く surface。 サービスカタログで変更を追跡し、四半期ごとに閾値をレビューし、次の launch ウィンドウ前に日付付き rollback チケットを紐付けてください。

game day で redacted prod sample を staging bus replay し load 下 contract validate。 次回の production review で再確認し、オーナーを割り当て、日付付き remediation チケットを紐付けてください。 サービスカタログで変更を追跡し、四半期ごとに閾値をレビューし、次の launch ウィンドウ前に日付付き rollback チケットを紐付けてください。

sections.heading: deploy 順序に依存しない async contract
paragraphs: producer が consumer 未 verify の schema change を ship すると event-driven system は静かに fail。published event schema を HTTP OpenAPI 同様に：semver breaking、consumer-driven contract suite、merge 前 CI provider verification。CloudEvents envelope は助けだが payload field は compatibility rule と prod cardinality fixture が要る。

Pact は両側：consumer が expectation publish、producer が recorded scenario で matching shape emit を証明。verify fail 時 consumer だけでなく producer deploy も block。version negotiation header か topic suffix が silent dual write より良い。

DLQ は log grep より poison message と schema drift を速く surface。depth、lag、event type 別 error taxonomy を metric。contract test に negative case：unknown field ignore、required missing、enum extension forward without crash。PR template リンク catalog に event type ownership。

game day で redacted prod traffic sample を staging bus に replay し load 下で contract change validate。legal/privacy review は event payload に REST body 同様適用。full payment/health event を shared topic に log しない。四半期 audit で emit schema を registry と diff し orphan topic retire。
